events.note:
Ernst Zellmer was a German soldier who was killed in action in World War 2 in Bashkino, Tula Oblast, Soviet Union on May 7, 1943. He held the rank of Gefreiter (Private) in Grenadier-Regiment 258 as part of the VIII Armeekorps of the Wehrmacht.

Grenadier-Regiment 258 was formed on 15 October 1942 by renaming Infanterie-Regiment 258 of the 112th Infantry Division . The regiment was divided into two battalions, each with four companies, and the 13th and 14th companies. As a replacement for the missing III. Battalion was formed on December 5, 1942 as a basis for this battalion, a 9th company. After operations in the Orel Bend until August 1943, the regiment fought east of Kiev and on the Dnieper from September. In these heavy defensive battles, the regiment suffered heavy losses. The regiment was finally disbanded on November 2, 1943. The staff formed the staff of Division Group 112, the 2nd Battalion formed Regimental Group 258.

(from https://www.lexikon-der-wehrmacht.de/Gliederungen/Grenadieregimenter/GR258-R.htm)


On April 11, 1943, the order to reorganize the division was received, which brought the following changes: Division Battalion 208, Field Replacement Battalion 208 and Panzerjäger Battalion 208 were reorganized. Rapid Division 208 and the Panzerjäger Battalion were dissolved and Cycle Squadron 208 was incorporated into Division Battalion 208. The 309th Grenadier Regiment, reinforced by the 208th Artillery Regiment, had to take over the sector of the 258th Grenadier Regiment of the 112th Infantry Division on April 21st. A day later the division was given command of the Bashkino-Vygonovsky area previously assigned to the 112th Infantry Division. The division was back in action after being detached 25 days earlier from the area north of Shisdra for refreshment and rest.

Since the interim refresher was only carried out as "ongoing repairs" and the division received only small allocations of personnel and material, the previous level of personnel and material had by no means been reached. Only a few days were available for the integration and training of the replacements that had arrived. In addition, the II./Grenadier-Regiment 337 and the II./Grenadier-Regiment 338 were assigned to a gang operation 20 km north of Karachev. But the ordered rest days alone had had a very favorable effect on the condition of the troops. At the end of April, the 309th Grenadier Regiment was withdrawn and marched to its old quarters near Bolchow. At the same time, the division returned the Bashkino-Vygonovsky sector to the 112th Infantry Division, and now the division and its regiments could continue training and integrating the replacement. It was not until mid-May 1943 that the division was reclaimed when the 309th Grenadier Regiment and the 208th Artillery Regiment were relocated to the Uljanowo area. In the main, the regiment was used there to build positions. At the beginning of June 43, the Soviets succeeded in pushing the 112th Infantry Division out of its positions between Tolkachevo and Palchikovo and establishing a bridgehead across the Oka.

(from https://lexikon-der-wehrmacht.de/Gliederungen/Infanteriedivisionen/208ID-R.htm)
